captionNumbering.sourceCaption: Figure 1. Schematic of the carotenoid metabolic pathway and target product synthesis in this project. The endogenous MEP pathway supplies IPP/DMAPP precursors for carotenoid biosynthesis in Dunaliella salina. β-Carotene is cleaved by AtCCD1 to produce β-ionone; zeaxanthin and β-cryptoxanthin are cleaved by CitCCD4 to produce β-citraurin.
